label: Amazon S3 Backup Bucket
description: Sends Backup Set and archive CSV files to an Amazon S3 bucket your organization owns. Salesforce signs each upload with AWS Signature Version 4, so the secret access key stays in the External Credential. Use an IAM user whose only permission is s3:PutObject on this bucket. The bucket name must have no dots.

urlParams.name: bucket
urlParams.label: Bucket name
urlParams.help: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens, no dots.

urlParams.name: region
urlParams.label: Region
urlParams.help: The bucket's region, such as us-east-1.
